name: futures_midweek_gap_is_a_feed_failure
why: The counterpart to the weekend case. A market-calendar explanation must not stretch to a Thursday with Monday's prices: the Yahoo chart endpoint answers 429 without a browser User-Agent and delists expired contract symbols, and either one stops the feed without failing the load, because per-symbol failures are logged rather than raised.
